quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Network and computer systems administrators install, configure and maintain an organisation's local and wide area networks, operating systems and servers; they monitor system health, control user access and keep software up to date.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Network and Computer Systems Administrators) include Network Administrator, Network Engineer, Network Analyst and LAN Administrator.

quick_facts.label: Typical preparation
quick_facts.value: O*NET places this occupation in Job Zone Three (medium preparation needed): most occupations in this zone require training in vocational schools, related on-the-job experience, or an associate's degree.

sections.heading: What a systems administrator does
paragraphs: Network and computer systems administrators install, configure and maintain an organisation's local and wide area networks, operating systems and servers; they monitor system health, control user access and keep software up to date.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Network and Computer Systems Administrators. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Plan and put in place network security measures that protect data, software and hardware.
Take data backups and carry out disaster recovery.
Diagnose and fix hardware, software and other network and system problems.
Talk to network users about solutions to system problems.

sections.heading: How people get into this job
paragraphs: O*NET places this occupation in Job Zone Three (medium preparation needed): most occupations in this zone require training in vocational schools, related on-the-job experience, or an associate's degree.
O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Common routes into this job on the Career Tree map: BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications); IT Support Specialist.
Less common routes on the map: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering; B.Sc (Bachelor of Science); Certificate in Computer Applications; Polytechnic Diploma (Engineering).
